We follow the wavefront sensing approach of [5] with a modal basis [6–8]. The deformable mirror model follows [5]. Calibration uses the method in [1]. Noise handling extends [12-14] and [0].

Free-space optical links suffer from turbulence [1]. Prior surveys cover this topic well [2, 3]. Early work used fast tip-tilt mirrors [4]. Background on scintillation is in [10].

We follow the wavefront sensing approach of [5] with a modal basis [6–8]. The deformable mirror model follows [5]. Calibration uses the method in [1]. Noise handling extends [12-14] and [0].

Our Strehl ratio exceeds the baseline of [6] by 20 percent. Compared with [9], latency is halved [5]. Short [2]. (Table 2) lists the numbers in [11].

citation.citation_body:
Free-space optical links suffer from turbulence [1]. Prior surveys cover this topic well [2, 3]. Early work used fast tip-tilt mirrors [4]. Background on scintillation is in [10].

We follow the wavefront sensing approach of [5] with a modal basis [6–8]. The deformable mirror model follows [5]. Calibration uses the method in [1]. Noise handling extends [12-14] and [0].

Our Strehl ratio exceeds the baseline of [6] by 20 percent. Compared with [9], latency is halved [5]. Short [2]. (Table 2) lists the numbers in [11].

[3] Wong A, Lee B. Survey of atmospheric channel models and statistics, IEEE Commun. Surv. 2015.

citation.citation_body:
Free-space optical links suffer from turbulence [1]. Prior surveys cover this topic well [2, 3]. Early work used fast tip-tilt mirrors [4]. Background on scintillation is in [10].

We follow the wavefront sensing approach of [5] with a modal basis [6–8]. The deformable mirror model follows [5]. Calibration uses the method in [1]. Noise handling extends [12-14] and [0].

Our Strehl ratio exceeds the baseline of [6] by 20 percent. Compared with [9], latency is halved [5]. Short [2]. (Table 2) lists the numbers in [11].
citation.citation_references:
[1] A. Smith, B. Jones, and C. Lee, “Turbulence in free-space links,” Opt. Express 12, 1-10 (2004).
[2] Kim, J. et al. Adaptive optics review for communication systems. Nature Photonics 5, 100 (2011).
[3] Wong A, Lee B. Survey of atmospheric channel models and statistics, IEEE Commun. Surv. 2015.
[4] R. Tyson, Principles of Adaptive Optics, 3rd edition, CRC Press, 2010.
[5] Dongju Kim and Hana Park, "Modal wavefront sensing with neural networks", Optica 7, 2020.
[6] Lee, C., Smith, A., Zhou, Q., Deformable mirror control at kilohertz rates. Appl. Opt. 45 (2006)
[7] ???
[8] Doe J (2019) A study without any journal name at all
[9]   Brown K. et al.   Latency budgets    in adaptive optics loops. J. Opt. Soc. Am. A 30, 2013.
[10] Introduction to scintillation, lecture notes 1999.
[11] Garcia M, Wavefront statistics for strong turbulence regimes. Phys. Rev A 88, 2019
[12] Chen L., Noise models. 2001.
[13] Patel R. & Singh V. 2003. Photon noise limits in sensors.
[14] Muller H. Ann. Phys. 2008.

Free-space optical links suffer from turbulence [1]. Prior surveys cover this topic well [2, 3]. Early work used fast tip-tilt mirrors [4]. Background on scintillation is in [10].

We follow the wavefront sensing approach of [5] with a modal basis [6–8]. The deformable mirror model follows [5]. Calibration uses the method in [1]. Noise handling extends [12-14] and [0].

Our Strehl ratio exceeds the baseline of [6] by 20 percent. Compared with [9], latency is halved [5]. Short [2]. (Table 2) lists the numbers in [11].

Free-space optical links suffer from turbulence [1]. Prior surveys cover this topic well [2, 3]. Early work used fast tip-tilt mirrors [4]. Background on scintillation is in [10].

We follow the wavefront sensing approach of [5] with a modal basis [6–8]. The deformable mirror model follows [5]. Calibration uses the method in [1]. Noise handling extends [12-14] and [0].

Our Strehl ratio exceeds the baseline of [6] by 20 percent. Compared with [9], latency is halved [5]. Short [2]. (Table 2) lists the numbers in [11].

We follow the wavefront sensing approach of [5] with a modal basis [6–8]. The deformable mirror model follows [5]. Calibration uses the method in [1]. Noise handling extends [12-14] and [0].
